title: Mona Lisa
description: The quintessential masterpiece of Renaissance sfumato technique, portraying Lisa Gherardini with subtle gradations of tone and an atmospheric background.

title: The Virgin and Child with Saint Anne
description: A triangular composition displaying geometric harmony, fluid figures, and a misty alpine background characteristic of Leonardo's geological studies.

title: Lady with an Ermine
description: A portrait of Cecilia Gallerani notable for its dynamic three-quarter turn, subtle muscular tension, and symbolic inclusion of an ermine.

title: The Creation of Adam
description: One of the most celebrated frescoes in history, capturing the iconic near-touch between the divine outstretched finger and Adam.

title: The Entombment
description: An unfinished panel painting displaying Michelangelo's sculptural understanding of anatomy, weight, and emotional gravity in carrying figures.

title: The School of Athens
description: An epitome of High Renaissance architectural perspective, gathering ancient philosophers centered around Plato and Aristotle.

title: Madonna of the Meadow
description: Celebrated for its serene pyramidal composition, tender warmth, and radiant Tuscan landscape illuminated by clear daylight.

title: The Birth of Venus
description: An early Renaissance mythological triumph depicting Venus arriving upon the shore riding a giant scallop shell, greeted by the winds.

title: Primavera
description: An intricate allegorical garden containing hundreds of cataloged botanical species, celebrating the arrival of spring with classical figures.

title: The Arnolfini Portrait
description: A masterpiece of Early Netherlandish realism renowned for its optical precision, domestic symbolism, and a convex mirror reflecting the room.

title: The Madonna of Chancellor Rolin
description: Exemplifies exquisite detail in brocade textiles, tiled geometric flooring, and an expansive panoramic city viewed through Romanesque arches.

title: The Garden of Earthly Delights
description: A complex moralizing triptych spanning the creation of humanity in Eden, an imaginative realm of earthly life, and a nightscape of judgment.

title: Self-Portrait at Twenty-Eight
description: A landmark front-facing self-portrait adopting the compositional dignity of religious iconography, asserting the intellectual stature of the artist.

title: The Battle of Alexander at Issus
description: A dramatic cosmological battle scene where thousands of armored soldiers clash beneath a cosmic sunset and swirling clouds over the Mediterranean.

title: Isenheim Altarpiece: Crucifixion
description: A deeply moving Northern Renaissance altarpiece painted for a monastic hospital, displaying raw emotional gravity and spiritual expressiveness.

title: The Hunters in the Snow
description: A Northern landscape masterpiece capturing hunters and their hounds returning across snow-covered hills toward ice skaters below.

title: The Tower of Babel
description: Depicts human architectural ambition modeled after the Roman Colosseum, rendered with meticulous engineering and masons' stonework details.

title: The Triumph of Death
description: A grand moral panorama where allegorical forces traverse civilization across a charred, dramatic landscape.

title: Bacchus and Ariadne
description: A tour de force of Venetian color and theatrical movement capturing Bacchus leaping from his chariot under a glowing ultramarine sky.

title: Venus of Urbino
description: A celebrated study in color and domestic interior perspective that established a foundation for subsequent European figurative painting.

title: Bacchus, with Ariadne Crowned by Venus
description: A vibrant Mannerist celebration of Venetian harmony, featuring rhythmic circular dynamism and luminous choreography between figures.

title: The Wedding at Cana
description: A monumental Venetian banquet containing over 130 individualized figures, combining biblical narrative with opulent Renaissance court pageantry.

title: The Calling of Saint Matthew
description: The defining triumph of Baroque tenebrism, where a piercing diagonal beam of light cuts through a shadowy room to illuminate Matthew's calling.

title: The Supper at Emmaus
description: Captures the dramatic moment disciples recognize Christ, featuring intense foreshortening and a still-life basket at the edge of the table.

title: Judith Slaying Holofernes
description: A powerful demonstration of Baroque theatricality and physical realism, celebrated for Gentileschi's psychological force and chiaroscuro.

title: The Descent from the Cross
description: A majestic Flemish Baroque altarpiece displaying sweeping diagonal composition and the brilliant contrast between pale cloth and deep shadows.

title: Charles I at the Hunt
description: An elegant royal portrait portraying the English monarch in a relaxed outdoor hunting pose, redefining portraiture with pastoral grace.

title: The Night Watch
description: A revolutionary group portrait transforming a standard civic guard commission into a kinetic, theatrical scene energized by motion and illumination.

title: The Jewish Bride
description: An extraordinarily tender portrayal of affection, painted with rich, sculpted impasto that captures warm golden tones and tactile presence.

title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
description: Known as the 'Mona Lisa of the North', this tronie captivates viewers with its blue turban, soft facial lighting, and focal pearl ornament.

title: The Milkmaid
description: Elevates everyday domestic routine into quiet contemplation through pointillist dots of light reflected on bread and an earthenware jug.

title: Las Meninas
description: A complex dialogue on perspective and spatial depth, portraying Infanta Margarita, attendants, the painter at his easel, and monarchs in a mirror.

title: The Third of May 1808
description: A groundbreaking modern war depiction portraying the resistance of Spanish patriots, illuminated starkly by a ground lantern against dark night.

title: Saturn Devouring His Son
description: A powerful work from Goya's 'Black Paintings' expressing mythological drama and psychological intensity through bold, unrestrained brushwork.

title: Wanderer above the Sea of Fog
description: The quintessential emblem of Romantic sublime, showing a solitary traveler gazing out over a swirling sea of mountain fog from a rocky crag.

title: The Sea of Ice
description: Depicts a polar expedition vessel engulfed beneath colossal, jagged slabs of monolithic ice, illustrating nature's sovereign power.

title: The Raft of the Medusa
description: A monumental Romantic epic chronicling shipwreck survivors, employing dynamic diagonal pyramids between despair and hopeful rescue.

title: Liberty Leading the People
description: Commemorates the July Revolution of 1830, led by an allegorical figure holding the tricolor flag over barricades amid smoke and citizens.

title: The Fighting Temeraire
description: A poetic tribute to the age of sail, showing a veteran warship being towed by a steam tug into a fiery sunset on the Thames.

title: Rain, Steam and Speed – The Great Western Railway
description: Dissolves industrial machinery, driving rain, and atmospheric mist into radiant energy as a locomotive crosses the Maidenhead Railway Bridge.

title: The Hay Wain
description: A pastoral masterpiece of rural English landscape on the River Stour, celebrated for Constable's meteorological realism and white highlights.

title: A Burial at Ornans
description: A manifesto of 19th-century Realism treating an ordinary provincial funeral on the monumental scale previously reserved for grand history painting.

title: The Desperate Man (Self-Portrait)
description: An intense psychological self-portrait capturing dramatic emotion through wide eyes and hands grasping disheveled hair against a dark backdrop.

title: The Gleaners
description: Dignifies rural labor through three peasant women bending across sun-bleached stubble fields to collect leftover grain after the harvest.

title: Le Déjeuner sur l'herbe
description: Marked a pivotal transition toward modern art at the Salon des Refusés by contrasting classical bathers with modern Parisian figures in a forest.

title: Olympia
description: Reimagined classical reclining figures into a contemporary Parisian scene, celebrated for its direct gaze and flat pictorial lighting.

title: A Bar at the Folies-Bergère
description: Manet's final salon masterpiece exploring modern urban atmosphere, featuring complex spatial reflections across a vast background mirror.

title: Impression, Sunrise
description: The historic harbor view of Le Havre whose loose, atmospheric handling of morning light gave the Impressionist movement its name.

title: Woman with a Parasol - Madame Monet and Her Son
current_location: National Gallery of Art, Washington D.C.
description: A masterclass in plein-air illumination capturing summer breeze, floating clouds, and sunlight across meadow grass with spontaneous brushwork.

title: Water Lilies (Nymphéas)
current_location: National Museum of Western Art, Tokyo
description: An immersive, horizon-free canvas reflecting sky, willow branches, and aquatic flowers across the surface of Monet's Giverny water garden.

title: Dance at Le Moulin de la Galette
description: Celebrates Parisian weekend leisure with dappled sunlight filtering through acacia leaves onto dancing couples and outdoor cafe tables.

title: Luncheon of the Boating Party
description: A warm snapshot of camaraderie along the Seine balcony at Maison Fournaise, combining sparkling still-life with expressive portraits.

title: The Ballet Class
description: Demonstrates Degas's oblique compositional framing and rehearsal realism, observing dancers stretching and adjusting attire under instruction.

title: In a Café (The Absinthe Drinker)
description: A perceptive study of solitude in urban café life, characterized by an asymmetric table arrangement and muted earthy color palette.

title: Paris Street; Rainy Day
description: An expansive wide-angle view of Parisian boulevards, shimmering with wet cobblestone reflections and geometric umbrella arrangements.

title: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte
description: The monumental manifesto of Pointillism, composing a tranquil frieze of island leisure on the Seine using disciplined dots of pure color.

title: The Card Players
description: Treats Provençal peasants with sculptural solidity through deliberate structural brushwork, balanced composition, and focused stillness.

title: Mont Sainte-Victoire seen from Bellevue
description: Constructs the Mediterranean landscape through interlocking structural planes, laying foundational principles for 20th-century geometric art.

title: The Starry Night
current_location: Museum of Modern Art, New York
description: An expressive vision of celestial rhythms and glowing stars swirling above a quiet Saint-Rémy village and dark vertical cypress.

title: Sunflowers (Vase with Fifteen Sunflowers)
description: A symphonic study in yellow impasto painted for the Yellow House in Arles, demonstrating Van Gogh's expressive mastery of radiant color.

title: Café Terrace at Night
description: Van Gogh's first nocturne painting without black pigment, contrasting the bright yellow glow of the terrace lanterns with a deep starry sky.

title: Where Do We Come From? What Are We? Where Are We Going?
description: A monumental allegorical canvas moving across the stages of life, featuring stylized figures and symbolic flora against a luminous blue background.

title: At the Moulin Rouge
description: Evokes nocturnal Parisian bohemian culture through theatrical green lighting, candid silhouettes, and oblique cropping.

title: The Sleeping Gypsy
current_location: Museum of Modern Art, New York
description: A poetic dreamscape depicting a sleeping traveler with a mandolin bathed in clear moonlight as a lion stands peacefully nearby in the desert.

title: The Kiss (Der Kuss)
medium: Oil and gold leaf on canvas
description: The pinnacle of Klimt's 'Golden Phase', wrapping two figures in ornate Byzantine-style mosaic robes upon a cliff carpeted with wildflowers.

title: Portrait of Adele Bloch-Bauer I
medium: Oil, silver, and gold leaf on canvas
description: A radiant fusion of Vienna Secession portraiture and intricate golden geometric abstraction, known as the 'Woman in Gold'.

title: Self-Portrait with Chinese Lantern Plant
description: An Austrian Expressionist self-portrait marked by expressive linear contours, psychological intensity, and red lantern fruits.

title: The Scream
medium: Oil, tempera, and pastel on cardboard
description: A landmark icon of modern angst, capturing a stylized figure on a bridge as an undulating blood-orange sky reverberates through the landscape.

title: Madonna
description: Reinterprets traditional devotional iconography with fluid undulating contours and a luminous, dramatic halo against dark tones.

title: The Joy of Life (Le Bonheur de Vivre)
description: A Fauvist triumph of saturated color harmonies and fluid arabesques, depicting dancing and reclining figures in an idyllic pastoral setting.

title: Dance (I)
current_location: Museum of Modern Art, New York
description: Distills pictorial composition into three essential components—deep blue sky, green hill, and pink dancing figures linked in a dynamic circle.

title: Les Demoiselles d'Avignon
current_location: Museum of Modern Art, New York
description: A revolutionary proto-Cubist composition breaking traditional perspective through fragmented geometric planes and Iberian-inspired facial forms.

title: Girl before a Mirror
current_location: Museum of Modern Art, New York
description: An inventive dual portrait exploring identity and reflection through vibrant stained-glass outlines, harlequin patterning, and rich color.

title: The Old Guitarist
description: The crowning work of Picasso's Blue Period, portraying an elderly seated musician holding a guitar through somber monochromatic blues.

title: Houses at l'Estaque
description: A seminal landscape that inspired the term 'Cubism', reducing hillside houses and trees into interlocking cubic volumes and planar facets.

title: Man with a Guitar
current_location: Museum of Modern Art, New York
description: An intricate example of Analytic Cubism, decomposing musician and instrument into a grid of muted ochre and grey planes with musical symbols.

title: Portrait of Pablo Picasso
description: A tribute to Picasso that systematized Analytic Cubism using precise diagonal grids, fractured facets, and disciplined blue-grey harmonies.

title: Simultaneous Windows on the City
description: A foundational work of Orphism celebrating light refraction, where views of urban landmarks dissolve into radiant chromatic chords.

title: The City
description: Captures post-war metropolitan dynamism with stylized graphic typography, scaffolding, mechanical cylinders, and rhythmic urban shapes.

title: Nude Descending a Staircase, No. 2
description: A milestone bridging Cubism and kinetic art, capturing continuous downward motion through overlapping geometric phases and chronophotographic lines.

title: The City Rises
current_location: Museum of Modern Art, New York
description: A dynamic Futurist painting portraying surging workhorses and laborers amid modern scaffolding, chimneys, and electric power.

title: Dynamism of a Dog on a Leash
description: Renders continuous movement through multiple superimposed views of a trotting dachshund's paws, leash oscillations, and walking feet.

title: Composition VII
description: Considered Kandinsky's greatest early abstract achievement, weaving swirling lines and chromatic chords into an expressive symphonic composition.

title: Composition VIII
current_location: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum, New York
description: Represents Kandinsky's Bauhaus period, organizing abstract spatial tension through intersecting geometric circles, acute angles, and lines.

title: The Large Blue Horses
description: Embodies Der Blaue Reiter's symbolic color theory, utilizing curving blue horses to express harmony, vitality, and connection with nature.

title: Fate of the Animals
description: A powerful composition depicting forest animals encircled by sharp crystalline facets and falling trees in a dynamic woodland scene.

title: Street, Berlin
current_location: Museum of Modern Art, New York
description: A defining German Expressionist street scene, depicting fashionably dressed pedestrians with angular silhouettes and vivid contrast.

title: Black Square
description: The radical cornerstone of Suprematism, stripping away illustrative representation to present pure non-objective geometric form.

title: Suprematist Composition
description: A dynamic arrangement of vibrant colored rectangles and planes arranged weightlessly across white space to explore spatial rhythm.

title: Composition with Red, Blue and Yellow
description: The pure embodiment of De Stijl Neo-Plasticism, creating visual balance through black orthogonal grids and primary color blocks.

title: Broadway Boogie Woogie
current_location: Museum of Modern Art, New York
description: Mondrian's dynamic canvas inspired by Manhattan's street grid, traffic rhythms, and jazz music, composed with vibrant pixelated color blocks.

title: Senecio (Head of a Man)
description: A whimsical Bauhaus portrait dividing a round, mask-like face into warm geometric patches of orange, yellow, and red.

title: Twittering Machine (Zwitscher-Maschine)
current_location: Museum of Modern Art, New York
description: A playful, inventive watercolor of mechanical birds perched along a crank mechanism, uniting organic nature with whimsical engineering.

title: I and the Village
current_location: Museum of Modern Art, New York
description: A dreamlike composition uniting folk memories and geometric shapes in a gentle mutual gaze between a green-faced villager and a white cow.

title: The Melancholy and Mystery of a Street
description: A classic Metaphysical painting featuring long arcade shadows, steep perspective, and the silhouette of a child with a hoop.

title: The Disquieting Muses
description: Presents an enigmatic deserted piazza occupied by mannequin-like statues and classical monuments beneath a silent, warm sky.

title: The Elephant Celebes
description: An early Surrealist work transforming industrial machinery into an imaginative round biomechanical creature within an open expanse.

title: Europe After the Rain II
description: Created using the decalcomania technique to produce an intricate, mineralized landscape of imaginative organic forms and stone-like ruins.

title: The Harlequin's Carnival
description: A lively celebration of biomorphic Surrealism populated by dancing organic forms, musical notes, ladders, and imaginative hybrid shapes.

title: The Hunter (Catalan Landscape)
current_location: Museum of Modern Art, New York
description: Transforms the Catalan countryside into an inventive visual shorthand of calligraphic lines, geometric marks, and organic symbols.

title: The Persistence of Memory
current_location: Museum of Modern Art, New York
description: The iconic Surrealist landscape featuring limp pocket watches draped over an olive tree and an enigmatic profile beside quiet coastal cliffs.

title: Swans Reflecting Elephants
description: Demonstrates Dalí's double-image method, where trees and swans mirrored in still pond waters appear as elephants in reflection.

title: The Treachery of Images
current_location: Los Angeles County Museum of Art
description: A famous conceptual painting juxtaposing a realistic pipe with the inscription 'Ceci n'est pas une pipe', examining image and language.

title: The Son of Man
description: A man in an overcoat and bowler hat before a seascape whose face is playfully obscured by a hovering green apple.

title: American Gothic
description: The iconic Regionalist portrait of a solemn rural couple standing before an Iowa house built with Carpenter Gothic window architecture.

title: Nighthawks
description: The celebrated depiction of nocturnal urban life, showing four patrons illuminated through the glass windows of a corner diner.
